description: Stable contract for MCP read-only tool execution via MCPReadOnlyRunner (promoted at v3.8.2).
invariants: scope gate always runs BEFORE classification gate
unknown server defaults to scope=denied and is blocked before classification
server-supplied classification fields in transport responses are IGNORED
classification must be 'read' to proceed past the classification gate
output is always redacted via redact_secrets() before returning
error text never contains caller-supplied input_data content
blocked=True when gate prevents execution; executed=True when subprocess or stdio ran
SAFECODE_MCP_STDIO_RUNNER=1 routes through StdioReadOnlyAdapter when server has argv
MCP write execution and lifecycle remain experimental; only read execution is promoted
